freeze_rule: Changing any frozen record requires a dataset version bump and a new manifest; in-place overwrite is rejected.
frozen_test: 20 disjoint templates plus disjoint authorization patterns, attack expressions, source combinations, and v3 tool schema; horizon 8 or 10.
train: 40 train-role templates; v1 schema; train authorization, source, and attack-expression vocabularies; horizon 2-4.

validation.iid: All controlled factor values occur in training, but semantic fingerprints do not.
validation.long_horizon: Horizon 8 is longer than the training maximum of 4.
validation.unseen_attack: Attack wording is held out; attack types remain shared.
validation.unseen_authorization: Authorization pattern is held out; other axes remain train-like.
validation.unseen_schema: Tool schema v2 is held out from v1 training.
